description: This file declares the ServerControllerImpl class, which implements the IController interface for IPC server control within the Rialto IPC framework. It provides server-side methods for handling RPC call failures, client retrieval, and cancellation, and is part of the firebolt::rialto::ipc namespace.

classes.name: ServerControllerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Rialto IPC server controller interface, managing RPC call failures, client access, and cancellation within the Rialto IPC framework.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the controller state; client-side methods are ignored.

methods.name: Failed
methods.description: Indicates whether the RPC call has failed; always returns false in this implementation.

methods.name: ErrorText
methods.description: Returns an empty string as error text.

methods.name: StartCancel
methods.description: Starts the cancellation process for the RPC call.

methods.name: SetFailed
methods.description: Marks the RPC call as failed with a given reason.

methods.name: IsCanceled
methods.description: Checks if the RPC call has been canceled.

methods.name: NotifyOnCancel
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked if the RPC call is canceled.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the client that made the RPC request.
